title: Czechy, West Pomeranian Voivodeship
text: Czechy [ˈt͡ʂɛxɨ] (German: Zechendorf) is a village in the administrative district of Gmina Grzmiąca, within Szczecinek County, West Pomeranian Voivodeship, in north-western Poland. It lies approximately 9 km (6 mi) north-east of Grzmiąca, 23 km (14 mi) north-west of Szczecinek, and 137 km (85 mi) east of the regional capital Szczecin.
